_architecture_notes: DIFFERENCE 1 - Explosion protection is an OPTIONAL CODE here (suffix /FF, /KF, /CF, etc.), NOT a core position like the AXG's FF2. The engine's 'explosion logic' transfers, but on the EJA it attaches as an optional-code group, not a fixed position.

DIFFERENCE 2 - NEW capability module required: range/span/turndown. The capsule code (position: Measurement span) defines a span range; the customer's required span must fall within it. This module does not exist on the AXG. Data captured under range_span_module below.
SHARED - Wetted-parts compatibility gate transfers directly; on the EJA the wetted parts are the process connector + diaphragm (see wetted_parts_for_compatibility).
SHARED - Part-number concatenation logic transfers (preserve specific hyphens). Verified against datasheet example EJA530E-DAS4N-012NN/ (see part_number_format).

range_span_module._note: NEW capability for pressure transmitters. Validate the customer's required span/range against the chosen capsule code.
range_span_module.validation_rule: Customer's required span must be >= the capsule's min span and <= the capsule's max span (URL). If the required span falls in an overlap between capsules, prefer the capsule where the required span sits comfortably above its minimum (better turndown = better accuracy). Flag if required span is below the smallest capsule's minimum or above the largest capsule's maximum.

calibration_rule._note: Allied tribal knowledge (confirmed 2026-06-10): the customer's stated range is not only used to pick the capsule - it becomes the factory CALIBRATED range the unit ships set to. This is a recorded order deliverable, distinct from capsule selection.
calibration_rule.three_point_calibration: Yokogawa calibrates at three points: 0, the span MIDPOINT, and full span. For a stated 0-100 psi range -> calibrate 0 / 50 / 100. Midpoint = arithmetic center of the span (for a 0-start range, span/2). Ranges effectively always start at zero in Allied's service; if a non-zero start ever occurs (e.g. 20-120), midpoint is the true center (20 / 70 / 120).
calibration_rule.stated_range: When the customer gives a specific range, RECORD it as the calibrated range on the quote/order and calibrate 0 / (mid) / (full). Carry the range through - do not consume it only to pick the capsule and then drop it.
calibration_rule.no_range_default: When NO range is stated, calibrate to the chosen capsule's FULL span. For the standard capsule B that is 0 / 145 / 290 psi (145 = midpoint of B's 290 psi max span). This is a real intended default, not a placeholder: no customer range -> ship calibrated to full capsule span, field-rerangeable later.
calibration_rule.turndown_link: The calibrated span relative to the capsule's max span IS the turndown ratio (e.g. 100 psi calibrated on capsule B's 290 max = 2.9:1). Compute turndown from the calibrated range and surface the accuracy note when high.
calibration_rule.output_on_quote: Every pressure-transmitter quote should state the calibrated range (e.g. 'Calibrated 0-100 psi') as a deliverable line, in addition to the model code.

range_span_module.turndown_note: Turndown = max span / set span. Yokogawa accuracy degrades at very high turndown; flag for review if the customer's set span requires turndown beyond a comfortable ratio (verify the exact accuracy-vs-turndown formula from the datasheet accuracy section, lines ~380-490, before encoding a hard threshold).
range_span_module.verify: Confirm min/max span figures and exact turndown ratios from the datasheet performance section. The kPa/MPa/psi values above are read from the model-code capsule table and should be cross-checked against the Span and Range Limits table.
